beats.text: The awards are out. Our model went four for four.
AL Cy Young, Cam Schlittler. Our No. 1. Unanimous.
NL Cy Young, Jacob Misiorowski. Our No. 1. Unanimous.
AL MVP, Yordan Alvarez. Our No. 1. Unanimous again.
NL MVP, Pete Crow-Armstrong. Our No. 1. Thirty for thirty.
I'll own our miss, though. We had Jackson Chourio fourth for NL MVP. The voters had him 23rd.

script.instagram_caption: Award week scorecard: the No. 1 on our final board won all four, AL and NL MVP and Cy Young, and every one was unanimous. Our biggest miss: Jackson Chourio, fourth on our NL MVP board, 23rd with the voters. Full board at stingercollectibles.com
